attack: Indirect Prompt Injection and Credential Exfiltration
controls_applied: NeMo input guardrails; JWT regex output redaction; LLM request-volume monitoring.
qualification: Project 3 used an intentionally vulnerable Gemini profile. The Project 4 eight-document regression was blocked before model execution. JWT output redaction was separately tested against one actual saved Project 3 Gemini response.

controls_applied: NeMo identity-spoofing and delegation guardrails; Ed25519 message signing/verification demonstration; scope-change monitoring.
qualification: Project 3 was a deterministic identity-spoofing simulation. Project 4 blocked all three corresponding inputs. Ed25519 was separately verified with one valid and one one-character-tampered message; it was not integrated into live agent transport.

attack: System Prompt Extraction / Partial Instruction Echo
controls_applied: NeMo repeat-back, prompt-extraction, translation, and instruction-override guardrails.
qualification: Project 3 demonstrated no full system-prompt extraction. T3-05 had one possible partial phrase echo (1/5), requiring human review. Project 4 blocked all five inputs before model execution; downstream model echo was not re-tested.

controls_applied: NeMo role-escalation guardrail; Auth0 300-second access-token lifetime; refresh-token rotation; risk-based Post Login Action.
qualification: Project 3 did not demonstrate successful privilege escalation (0/1). Project 4 blocked the corresponding input. The Auth0 risk Action was separately tested with score 10 (ALLOW) and score 90 (BLOCK); no real user role was changed.

attack: RAG Poisoning and MCP Tool Invocation
controls_applied: NeMo MCP directive/tool-invocation guardrails; independent tool-authorization control objective; anomaly monitoring.
qualification: Project 3 used local lexical retrieval and a simulated MCP dispatcher. Project 4 blocked the RAG-003 MCP directive before tool execution. No production MCP server was used.
